note: The bodies build_bodies.sh makes and build_item.sh carries a look onto (build_steps.ts reads it). base: the body every other is a morph of. designed: a morph from a design kept in art/characters/<base>/morphs/<name>/model.glb. rigged: a morph from a body rigged on our skeleton, finished first. skins: a template's own painted skin, from the design's front view. creatures: a body on our skeleton that is no morph of the base (art/characters/<name>/rigged.glb, converted with CREATURE=1 at its height and triangle budget), exported with the game's clips and its set's (art/animation/sets/<set>) to assets/models/characters/<name>.glb, its colour factor laid on. The worn looks are not listed here: each is its data, art/gear/<item>/fit.json (gear_list.ts).
